[muse compare muse] verdict=pass; model notes: evidence: source 'ὁ θεὸς τῶν Χριστιανῶν τόπῳ οὐ περιγράφεται, ἀλλὰ ἀόρατος ὢν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν πληροῖ' // english 'for the God of the Christians is not confined by any place, but though unseen he fills heaven and earth (Jeremiah 23:24)'; parenthetical reference is paratext not in source but target is correct and adds no doctrine, and source 'Ἐγὼ ἐπάνω μένω τινὸς Μαρτίνου τοῦ Τιμοθίνου βαλανείου' // english 'I am staying above the bathhouse of a certain Martinus, son of Timothinus' preserves agency and place
